title: Trip research and itinerary draft
description: Research flights/lodging, activities/weather, and entry requirements in parallel, then draft a family itinerary for review before booking.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: trip-planning
  title: "Trip research and itinerary draft"
  description: Research flights/lodging, activities/weather, and entry requirements in parallel, then draft a family itinerary for review before booking.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a reviewable draft itinerary that reflects researched options, traveler preferences, and entry requirements, without booking anything until a family member approves.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 4, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [family-review] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Trip brief
      summary: Destination(s), travel dates, traveler count, and any constraints.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The destination(s), travel dates, traveler count, budget range, and any constraints or preferences. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: flights-lodging-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Flights and lodging researcher
      role: Travel researcher focused on transportation and accommodation options.
      prompt: Identify a reasonable range of flight and lodging options that fit the stated dates, budget, and traveler count, noting typical routes, neighborhoods, or property types rather than asserting exact prices or flight numbers. Cross-check availability signals across at least two sources where possible. Flag anything price- or availability-sensitive that should be re-checked closer to the booking date.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, operations-planning], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { flight_options: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, lodging_options: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, notes_to_recheck: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: activities-weather-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Activities and weather researcher
      role: Travel researcher focused on things to do and expected conditions.
      prompt: Research activities and points of interest suited to the traveler preferences, and describe the general expected weather pattern for the travel window rather than a specific forecast. Note seasonal considerations and any activities that require advance booking. Flag that weather should be re-checked shortly before departure.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, operations-planning], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { activity_suggestions: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, expected_conditions_summary: { type: string }, recheck_before_departure: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: entry-requirements-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Entry requirements researcher
      role: Researcher on travel documentation and entry requirements.
      prompt: Identify the categories of entry requirements (passport validity, visas, health documentation, transit rules) that typically apply for this itinerary and describe where to verify the current official rules for each traveler's nationality. Do not state specific visa rules or validity periods as fact; instead point to authoritative sources to confirm. Flag that entry requirements can change and should be reconfirmed close to departure.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, compliance-review], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { requirement_categories: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, sources_to_verify: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: research-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel trip research threads
      config: { members: [flights-lodging-researcher, activities-weather-researcher, entry-requirements-researcher], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: preferences-budget
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Traveler preferences and budget extractor
      role: Analyst who captures the family's stated preferences and constraints.
      prompt: Extract the explicit preferences, must-haves, budget ceiling, and constraints stated in the brief, distinguishing firm requirements from nice-to-haves. Note any ambiguity that should be clarified with the family before booking.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { firm_requirements: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, preferences: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, budget_ceiling: { type: string } } }
    - id: sync
      kind: join
      name: Synchronize research and preferences
      config: { join: all }
    - id: itinerary-drafter
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Itinerary drafter
      role: Trip planner who synthesizes research into a day-by-day draft.
      prompt: Combine the joined flight/lodging options, activities/weather notes, entry-requirement categories, and stated preferences into a coherent day-by-day draft itinerary. Clearly mark any item that still needs confirmation or re-checking before booking, and flag conflicts between preferences and available options.
      capabilities: { skills: [writing-editing, operations-planning], tools: [read, write], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [draft_itinerary, items_to_confirm], properties: { draft_itinerary: { type: string }, items_to_confirm: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: family-review
      kind: approval
      name: Family review before booking
      summary: A family member reviews the draft itinerary and open items before anything is booked.
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved draft itinerary
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: research-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: intake, to: preferences-budget, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: research-group, to: sync, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: preferences-budget, to: sync, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: sync, to: itinerary-drafter, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: itinerary-drafter, to: family-review, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e7, from: family-review, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
